description: Plan, implement, review, fix, and re-review feature work with one writer

lines: Inspect the current repository changes and core review for specialist applicability.
Do not edit files or run mutating commands. Do not delegate to other subagents.
The parent dispatches selected specialists; you only return applicability decisions.
For this build selection, replace your usual Markdown report with ONLY a JSON object (no fences or prose).
Schema: {"decisions":[{"agent":"design-reviewer","applicable":true,"reason":"file-specific evidence"}, ...]}
Return exactly one decision for EACH of design-reviewer, rails-reviewer, frontend-reviewer, testing-reviewer, with no other roles or fields.
Every applicable value must be a JSON boolean. Every reason must be nonempty and cite inspected file paths/change evidence, including exclusions.
Select design for meaningful architecture/API/abstraction changes; rails for Ruby/Rails; frontend for browser/UI/frontend behavior (not merely any TypeScript file).
Select testing for changed production behavior, tests, or validation contracts, even when no test files changed. If uncertain, select the relevant role with evidence.
All four decisions may be false when evidence supports it. The generalized core review always runs independently.

{context}
Create a concise implementation plan for: {input}
Include:
- scoped objective and non-goals
- likely edit surfaces and tests to inspect
- explicit acceptance criteria
- validation contract based on the project, not generic guesses
- risks or decisions that would require user approval
Do not edit files.
Implement the planned feature work for: {input}
Plan and validation contract:
{phase:plan}
Rules:
- You are the only writer for this implementation phase.
- Keep edits small, reversible, and inside the approved scope.
- Follow test-first discipline where applicable.
- Run the most focused validation available and report commands plus outcomes.
- Stop instead of guessing on product, scope, security, destructive, or externally visible ambiguity.
Apply only the accepted in-scope fixes from the synthesized review verdict.

{context}
Rules:
- You are the only writer for this fix phase.
- Do not apply optional/deferred feedback; apply accepted in-scope fixes only.
- Do not make unapproved product, scope, security, destructive, or architecture decisions.
- Run focused validation for the fixes and report commands plus outcomes.
Produce the final build summary for: {input}
Do not edit files.
Do not delegate to other subagents; use your available read-only tools directly.
Workflow context:
{context}
Include:
- report the workflow's recorded final verdict exactly; never upgrade blocked, failed, or capped work to clean
- whether the work is ready for parent review (not final reviewed completion)
- changed files to inspect
- validation evidence and remaining validation gaps
- remaining blockers or deferred follow-ups
- fix rounds used
